text: Inagore Oinore ire udo pagera pudogidure .
Inagore Ire udo pagera awubodure pagera metuiare pobema awu metuia bokware .
Ire udo nono pu reore tu...Ha, ha, ha !
Kodire inagore oino tai, tawo tamaragodu rakado ia tamaragodaere jiboe ji ma, tawo udo turugadu, nowu meri kae .
Imerure tu apo dukeje ure ido awu barege kugure ewido tu, ewido tu je .
Icare tamode ido tapira kodu ko .
Unure baigatu udo nono nono borore tugajeje: Iceba baiga atu cidugoduwo ii. Akore ioguduba ure joru tugu awu moto to ?
Ure udo pobe, ure metuia jeto woe, ure metuia jeto woje joku uruguwo oino jice pobo oiaji .
Itaregodu, imearudure atui mato duji, dukodire ire iodo iwugeje mato awogai. Akore cere turubare edo pobe .
Ure cedo jaedo pudui oino turegodaji .
Cere cedo mugudo je tadawu keje ta;
Icare ire ia ekurugo ire edo pobe .
Ure edo torudo jamedu, tugeje.,Aiwore nowu baperaji dukejere ro oino .
Ure nowu kare ewuodu rawujewugere, ure etogagiridowugere, ure sal tugu etowugere, ure ewarigu toro ira towugeje, tapira biri keje ere edo .
Salvador koiare ukare joru cedo ekudaeto .
Ure tudugu kuda...taci toro nowu joru kae, ure udo nowu tugudawu aroia kurirewu ure udo maedo joki !

Ure Boe edo kuiada tugudu kurido .
Ure udo Boe ekeroia bu bapera keje toce .
